key_terms.أَمَةَ اللَّهِ: Maid of Allah (address to the woman)

ai.seo_question: What is the correct formula and legal procedure for a temporary marriage (Mut'ah) in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the essential pillars of Mut'ah by specifying the verbal formula that includes both the duration (ajal) and the dowry (mahr). It highlights the unique Shia jurisprudential ruling that the expiration of the term results in an automatic, irrevocable divorce (talaq mubarrim) without the need for a formal declaration or a waiting period (iddah), distinguishing it from permanent marriage.
